title: The FACTS Grounding Leaderboard: Benchmarking LLMs' Ability to Ground Responses to Long-Form Input
authors_zh: Alon Jacovi 等（Google DeepMind、Google Research、Google Cloud、Kaggle）
paper_type_zh: arXiv preprint / Kaggle online benchmark 的 grounding evaluation surface
best_for_zh: 关注 benchmark、评分契约、污染风险、评测 harness 和后训练反馈可复用性的研究者。
one_line: FACTS Grounding exposes long-document grounding with public/private split and judge ensemble as an auditable evaluation surface.
FACTS Grounding 把带公开与私有划分、由评审集成打分的长文档依据核查做成可审计的评测面。
why: Private split plus grounding-specific scoring makes it useful for contamination-resistant evaluation.
inclusion_reason: high: judge-based grounding surface with public/private leaderboard and hidden-policy risks.

title: Problem
问题
html: FACTS Grounding asks whether long-form model responses are fully grounded in a provided long document and user request. The primary source is arXiv:2501.03200, with the official Kaggle FACTS Grounding benchmark/leaderboard as the public evaluation surface. It belongs here as a grounding benchmark with public/open and private/blind splits, not as a claim-extraction dataset or a general QA corpus. A task contains a user request, a full source document of up to 32K tokens, a model long-form answer, and judge outputs for eligibility and grounding. Its atlas value is the hidden-split, judge-ensemble feedback contract for document-grounded factuality.

FACTS Grounding 关注的问题是：模型长回答是否完全基于给定长文档和用户请求。主要来源是 arXiv:2501.03200，以及官方 Kaggle FACTS Grounding benchmark/leaderboard。这里收录它是因为它提供带 public/open 与 private/blind split 的 grounding 评测面，而不是 claim extraction 数据集或普通 QA 语料。一个任务包含用户请求、最长 32K tokens 的完整文档、模型长回答，以及 eligibility 和 grounding 的 judge 输出。它对 atlas 的价值是提供带隐藏集和 judge ensemble 的文档溯源事实性反馈契约。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is an online leaderboard for long-document response grounding with a two-stage judging contract. The mechanism first filters answers that fail the user request, then judges whether the remaining answer is fully supported by the source document; multiple judge models are aggregated to reduce judge-specific bias. The reported dataset has 860 public/open examples and 859 private/blind examples. Closest comparisons are FActScore, FEVER-style verification, RAG factuality metrics, and long-context QA benchmarks. The direction label is hidden-split grounding evaluation for long-form answers.

核心贡献是一个长文档回答 grounding leaderboard，并采用两阶段 judge 契约：先过滤未满足用户请求的回答，再判断剩余回答是否完全由源文档支持；多个 judge model 聚合以降低单一 judge 偏差。论文报告 860 个 public/open examples 和 859 个 private/blind examples。最近对比是 FActScore、FEVER 式验证、RAG factuality metric 和长上下文 QA benchmark。方向标签是长回答的 hidden-split grounding evaluation。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Inputs: a long document, user request, model answer, and benchmark split. 2. Pipeline: collect grounded-response tasks, run submitted model answers, apply an eligibility check for request satisfaction, judge grounding against the document, and aggregate judge outputs into the leaderboard score. 3. Outputs: response-level scores over public and private splits. 4. Feedback: a response receives credit only when it answers the request and all substantive claims are supported by the document under the official judge/rubric. 5. Reuse requires pinning Kaggle benchmark version, public/private split, judge model ensemble, prompts, maximum context, and submission date.

1. 输入：长文档、用户请求、模型回答和 benchmark split。2. 流程：构造 grounding 任务，收集提交回答，先做 request satisfaction 的 eligibility 检查，再根据文档判断 grounding，并聚合 judge 输出为 leaderboard 分数。3. 输出：public/private split 上的 response-level 分数。4. 反馈：只有回答满足请求且实质性声明均由文档支持时才给 credit。5. 复用前要固定 Kaggle benchmark 版本、public/private split、judge ensemble、prompt、最大上下文和提交日期。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports 1,719 examples split into 860 public/open and 859 private/blind cases, with documents up to 32K tokens. The evidence for a model score is the official two-stage judge result for each submitted response, not a manually inspectable claim table. The private split supports contamination resistance, but the score remains bounded by judge reliability, prompt wording, answer style, and Kaggle leaderboard policy. Later FACTS suite versions should not be mixed with this 2025 Grounding paper without version labels.

论文报告 1,719 个样本，其中 860 个 public/open、859 个 private/blind，文档最长 32K tokens。模型分数的证据是官方两阶段 judge 对每个提交回答的结果，而不是可直接人工浏览的 claim 表。private split 有助于抗污染，但分数仍受 judge 可靠性、prompt、回答风格和 Kaggle leaderboard 政策约束。后续 FACTS suite 版本不能和这篇 2025 Grounding 论文混写。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior factuality benchmarks often evaluate short claims, retrieved passages, or public answer sets. FACTS Grounding changes the setting to long-form answers grounded in long private/public documents with a leaderboard submission process. The quality signal is the hidden private split and explicit eligibility-plus-grounding judge. What is not new is using LLM judges for factuality. Before reuse, inspect judge prompts, aggregation, private split policy, unsupported partial-credit behavior, and whether answers are penalized for harmless omissions or style.

已有事实性 benchmark 多评估短 claim、检索段落或公开答案集。FACTS Grounding 把设置改成基于长 public/private 文档的长回答，并通过 leaderboard 提交评测。质量信号是 hidden private split 以及 eligibility + grounding 的显式 judge。LLM judge 做 factuality 并不新。复用前要查 judge prompt、聚合方式、private split 政策、unsupported partial-credit 行为，以及回答是否因无害遗漏或风格被惩罚。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is only relative to the official judges and rubric. A long answer may mix supported, unsupported, and irrelevant claims, making response-level scoring sensitive to segmentation and style. Private data improves contamination resistance but limits independent row-level auditing. Kaggle leaderboard rules, judge models, and hidden split can change. The benchmark should not be reused as training data unless license and hidden-split policy explicitly allow it.
正确性只相对于官方 judge 和 rubric 成立。长回答可能混合支持、未支持和无关声明，使 response-level scoring 对切分和风格敏感。private 数据提升抗污染，但限制逐样本独立审计。Kaggle 规则、judge 模型和隐藏集都可能变化。除非许可和隐藏集政策明确允许，否则不应把该 benchmark 当训练数据复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use FACTS Grounding as a schema for long-context grounding evaluation. Preserve document id, user request, context length, answer, eligibility decision, grounding decision, judge ensemble version, split, and submission date. It is useful for separating request satisfaction from factual support in RAG and long-context systems.

可把 FACTS Grounding 用作长上下文 grounding evaluation schema。复用时保留文档 id、用户请求、上下文长度、回答、eligibility decision、grounding decision、judge ensemble 版本、split 和提交日期。它适合在 RAG 与长上下文系统中区分 request satisfaction 和 factual support。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Do not read the score as claim-level precision. Read the eligibility filter, grounding judge, and split policy before comparing models. Public/Open examples, Private/Blind examples, and later FACTS versions must stay separate.
不要把分数理解成 claim-level precision。比较模型前先读 eligibility filter、grounding judge 和 split policy。Public/Open examples、Private/Blind examples 和后续 FACTS 版本必须分开。
